coordinator:
"""Offline argv-shape derivation; never resolve a revision or rerun Git."""
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import io
import json
import re
import sys
import tarfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools/xtask-git-trace-074'))
import trace_review

def request(argv):
    args = argv[1:]
    if args[:1] == ['--no-replace-objects']: args = args[1:]
    if not args or args[0] != 'show': return None
    if len(args) != 2 or ':' not in args[1]: return ('other_show_argv',json.dumps(args))
    revision,path = args[1].split(':',1)
    if re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',revision): return ('full_hex_file',args[1])
    if re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{4,39}',revision): return ('short_hex_file',args[1])
    return ('dynamic_or_other_file',args[1])

for argv,expected in [
    (['git','show','a'*40+':file'], 'full_hex_file'),
    (['git','--no-replace-objects','show','abcd:file'], 'short_hex_file'),
    (['git','show','HEAD:file'], 'dynamic_or_other_file'),
    (['git','show','--format=%H'], 'other_show_argv'),
    (['git','ls-tree','abcd'],None),
]:
    value = request(argv)
    assert (value[0] if value else None) == expected

folder = ROOT/'docs/testing/performance/0.74/local-runs/static-contract-trace-20261024'
raw = (folder/'index.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == '11e89b85754443b1c5ff818ebfa4e5fcd2e896d812a85065cac2ffe70389e085'
index = json.loads(raw)
def member(name):
    entry = index['members'][name]
    raw = (folder/'objects'/entry['sha256']).read_bytes()
    assert len(raw) == entry['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == entry['sha256']
    return raw

assert (ROOT/'tools/xtask-git-trace-074/trace_review.py').read_bytes() == member('source/current/tools/xtask-git-trace-074/trace_review.py')
ledger = json.loads(member('capture/git-trace2-members.json'))
counts = defaultdict(Counter)
roots = 0
seen = set()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(member('capture/git-trace2.tar.gz')),mode='r:gz') as archive:
    for item in archive:
        assert item.isfile() and item.name in ledger and item.name not in seen
        seen.add(item.name)
        raw = archive.extractfile(item).read()
        assert ledger[item.name] == dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
        if item.name.startswith('target-trace/'):
            session = trace_review.session(raw.decode())
            if not session['nested']:
                roots += 1
                value = request(session['argv'])
                if value: counts[value[0]][value[1]] += 1
assert seen == set(ledger) and roots == index['facts']['git']['root_sessions']
classes = {name:dict(requests=sum(values.values()),unique_raw_arguments=len(values),
    repeated_raw_arguments=sum(count-1 for count in values.values()),
    most_repeated=[dict(argument=key,requests=count) for key,count in sorted(values.items(),key=lambda pair:(-pair[1],pair[0]))[:5]])
    for name,values in sorted(counts.items())}
assert sum(value['requests'] for value in classes.values()) == index['facts']['git']['commands']['show']
record = dict(schema='hc074-static-trace-argv-shapes-v1',input_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256((folder/'index.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    archive_sha256=index['members']['capture/git-trace2.tar.gz']['sha256'],root_sessions=roots,
    classes=classes,synthetic_shape_controls=5,revision_resolution_performed=False,
    raw_argument_repetition_is_immutable_identity=False,cache_admission=False,
    new_measurement=False,package_retry=False,server=False,coordinator=Path(__file__).read_text())
data = (json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode()
out = ROOT/'docs/testing/performance/0.74/local-runs/static-contract-trace-shapes-20261024.json'
with out.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(data)
print(json.dumps(dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),root_sessions=roots,
    classes={name:{key:value for key,value in entry.items() if key!='most_repeated'} for name,entry in classes.items()}),indent=2))
